results.transcript: So, to all my dear boys and girls who have over the last 10 years been asking me to give them advice, tips, suggestions on how they can take care of their skin and share my secrets on what I do for my own skin, I finally have an answer for you. For the last 9 months, I have quietly been building something in skincare, a skincare solution for all of us. It's called Unhyped. I know it took 10 years, I'm sorry, but I didn't just want to launch anything that didn't meet my own standard. I'm very particular about what I use. I want products that work. I want products that are backed by science. I want to know exactly what ingredients are in them, what dosage the ingredients are in. I want every product that's tested, that's certified and I want to know why they cost what they cost. I want to be completely able to trust the product that I'm putting on my face every day. It turns out, it's surprisingly hard to find all of that in one place. You go to any platform, you see there are so many products. Every product making a different claim, a different promise. There are trends every month, changing trends. There's so much confusion and there's so much hype. But one year ago, I met a team that actually owns their own R&D facility, their own manufacturing facility. And they didn't want me to just be the face of another brand. They wanted me to co-build it with them. And I thought, yes, if I'm doing this, this is exactly how I want to do it. I want to build top of the line products, keep the costs low, make them simple to use, make products that actually work and cut out all the unnecessary hype. And get all of us into one really good habit, taking care of our skin from when we are young. So we started building simple routines in our own R&D and manufacturing facility. We spent months on the formulas. I've tried every single day. single version on my own face for nine months. Nine months later, here we are. Launching Unhype with these two signature routines first. The acne safe routine for oily and acne prone skin. The brightening routine for tan and dullness. Two routines to choose from. Three simple steps. Both made for our skin, our weather. For the real Indian conditions that we live in. Pre-book the signature routine now. And from the 21st, we'll start it together. I've already been using these for months now. I don't travel without them. I don't do anything. They're always in my kit. Now, you will join me.

results.caption: #AD | Retinol has a reputation for being drying and irritating…but it doesn't have to be👀 When @Olay Skin Care shared the clinical data behind their Regenerist Retinol24 Night Cream, I immediately started reading through it (because duh???🤓). I really appreciate that they looked beyond the improved appearance of wrinkles and had clinical evidence to also support an increase in cell turnover, hydration, and barrier function! Fill me in, what's your biggest skincare goal right now? 👇   #RetinolReveal #cosmeticscience #cosmeticchemist #skincare

💄BSPS Cosmetic Science and Formulation Design

results.transcript: I looked through Olay's clinical data on this moisturizer and I am sad. I am partnering with Olay to talk about the Regenerous Retinol 24 Night Cream because retinol doesn't need to be drying and irritating, y'all. Retinol works by encouraging skin cell turnover to bring healthier looking skin to the surface sooner. For you, this can mean improving uneven skin tone, texture, and the appearance of wrinkles over time. If y'all know anything about me, I'm a sucker for data. Show me the data. And Olay delivered so you best believe I took notes. In a cell turnover study, they confirmed that this formula accelerated the natural renewal process. It works, but we're just getting started. Also found the Regenerous Night Cream to significantly improve hydration for a full 24 hours after application. It improved skin barrier function after two weeks via transepidermal water loss measurements. And there was an average wrinkle reduction of 10%, which was statistically significant, by the way. All this data is music to my ears because not only is this telling me that the retinol is doing the work, it's also doing it without necessarily being too harsh. I personally have been using this at night to help with evening out my skin tone. But enough about me. I want to know what your biggest skincare goal is right now. Let me know in the comments. And if you've been thinking about incorporating a retinol in your routine, you can check out the Regenerous Retinol 24 night cream online or at your favorite retailer.
